summary: The plan leaves one runner decision and has three proof or runner conflicts.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] plan.md Phase 1 Task 1.1: The plan leaves the contract test runner and its file location to Red. Rationale: The two options change which files run the test and whether the four CI commands execute it.

F2 [Blocker] plan.md Phase 1 Task 1.3: The plan requires a throwaway branch push but permits pushes only to origin/chore/ci-workflow. Rationale: The proof cannot use a separate remote branch under both instructions.

F3 [Blocker] spec.md FR-1 and FR-5: The proof requires a red check on a throwaway branch, but branch pushes outside main do not trigger the workflow. Rationale: The plan must name a pull request or another permitted event for the red proof.

F4 [Blocker] spec.md FR-7: The spec requires a machine-specific wrapper for every long command without defining its availability or scope on the Actions runner. Rationale: The runner cannot execute that absolute path unless it exists, and Q2 does not resolve the mandatory wrapper requirement.
evidence: HEAD and baseline both resolve to 9ffdc8e781b581dd0e33087844a99b5d044d0d3e; the tree was clean before artifact creation.
Reviewed the track spec, plan, metadata, index, project context, four command scripts, and the no-CI debt row.
The two existing test runners discover tests only within their own directories.
Q1 and Q2 request runtime discovery; the findings identify separate unresolved choices or conflicts.
Zoom-out: the track addresses the CI gap and adds no apparent speculative feature or optimization.
Zero-decision: the test runner location is not fixed; branch proof and wrapper instructions conflict or lack runner scope.
commands: role-gate --role spec-review: exit 1; audit status fail

paraphrase.proposes: The track adds one GitHub Actions job for four existing checks on pull requests and pushes to main. It proves a green check and a deliberate red check, then configures or reports the required check. It closes the no-CI debt row.
paraphrase.current_system: The spec says the repository has no CI workflow. The four checks run as local scripts, and main has no branch protection.
